title: Stylized Chinese Lost Temple
units: meters, preserving source FBX import scale
lod_policy: Highest-detail render meshes only; lower LODs and collision helper geometry are excluded and listed per asset.
material_policy: Actual Unity Prefab material assignments rebuilt as portable metallic/roughness PBR. Custom ShaderGraph behavior is not preserved.
known_limits: Unity water distortion, foliage wind, particles, terrain blending, and baked scene lighting are not ported.
Unity scene and Prefab runtime components are not included in GLB modules. Source mappings are provided as metadata.
Normal-map tangents are generated by the rendering engine; see validation report.
The included character and panda meshes are static props, not rigged animation assets.

assets.name: SM_Character_Merged
warnings: The source Prefab leaves one material slot unassigned. A neutral fallback is retained for that slot.
